documents.title: Hybrid Retrieval
documents.content: Hybrid retrieval combines keyword search, dense vector retrieval, and score fusion to improve evidence recall.

documents.title: Corrective RAG
documents.content: Corrective retrieval augmented generation evaluates retrieved evidence and rewrites the query when document quality is poor.

documents.title: Agent Memory
documents.content: Long-term agent memory stores useful experiences and retrieves relevant observations for future planning and decision making.

documents.title: Cross Encoder Reranking
documents.content: A cross encoder jointly reads a query and candidate passage to rerank retrieval results with higher precision.

documents.title: HNSW Vector Index
documents.content: HNSW is an approximate nearest neighbor index that provides fast vector similarity search with strong recall.

documents.title: LLM Observability
documents.content: Production LLM observability tracks traces, model latency, token usage, cost, errors, and evaluation scores.

documents.title: Multilingual Embeddings
documents.content: Multilingual embedding models map semantically related text from different languages into nearby vector representations.

documents.title: Semantic Cache
documents.content: A semantic cache reuses answers for meaningfully similar requests to reduce model latency and inference cost.
